purpose: Teach: 月別/予備校/破損/労災/ストレージ/辞職/役に立っ/明言

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、月別の犯罪件数、報告いたします、毎月。
lines.en: We report monthly crime statistics to the police each month.
lines.style: Even, procedural tone. Steady pace. Official but not stiff. The rhythm of someone delivering routine information clearly and completely.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、予備校受験指導員、警察出身者にも、ご相談しています。
lines.en: Yes. We consult with our staff, our cram-school instructors, and our former police contacts.
lines.style: Engaged, responsive. Slight nod in the voice. Confirms understanding while adding substance. Professional but genuinely collaborative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 公共施設の破損、警察、巡回時、確認しております。
lines.en: Public facility damage is noted during our patrol rounds.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly formal. Steady delivery. No elaboration — just stating what is being done. The voice of someone following procedure without question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労災発生時、警察への通報、社内手順、定めております。
lines.en: Understood. When workplace injuries occur, we have an established internal procedure for notifying the police.
lines.style: Confirming and adding detail. Slight emphasis on 「established」— showing this isn't ad-hoc. Clear, bureaucratic but competent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 証拠データのストレージ、警察、専用システム、運用中です。
lines.en: We maintain a dedicated police system for evidence data storage.
lines.style: Flat, informational. Slight pride in the infrastructure without showing it. The tone of someone describing a system that works and is worth noting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者、辞職後の動向、警察、追跡されていますか。
lines.en: I see. Is the police tracking the suspect's movements since his resignation?
lines.style: Shift toward genuine inquiry. Leaning forward slightly in tone. Less procedural — this is a real question about real follow-through. Measured curiosity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。前回の協力、本当に、役に立った、と、署内、申しております。
lines.en: Yes. The station has mentioned that our previous cooperation was genuinely useful.
lines.style: Warmth enters for the first time. Slight softness around 「役に立った」. Still composed, but there's gratitude underneath — acknowledging the relationship.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察への協力姿勢、社長が、明言する予定です、来月。
lines.en: Understood. The president plans to make a public statement next month about our commitment to police cooperation.
lines.style: Closing note — slightly more formal again. Signals the conversation is concluding. Steady, assured. The tone of someone confirming a decision has been made at a higher level.
